errors.description: The claimed lead over CTQScorer is confounded by different example databases and test-set versions. Comparing these COMET scores cannot isolate the selection method or establish that the proposed selector performs better than CTQScorer.
errors.evidence: The manuscript states, 'Our proposed methods secure all the highest scores on all 6 translation directions,' but also states that CTQScorer uses Europarl and ParaCrawl and is evaluated on FLORES-101, whereas the proposed methods use WikiMatrix and FLORES+. It acknowledges that these differences 'may lead to an unequal comparison.'
